scope: Static review of previously retrieved explorer-verified token source, authenticated against fresh runtime bytes; no independent source recompilation or nonzero burn execution

source_findings.claim: Token is ERC20 plus ERC20Burnable; no Ownable/proxy inheritance, arbitrary external call/delegatecall or transfer callback is introduced by the leaf contract.
source_findings.evidence: Main inheritance plus inspected ERC20/Burnable/Context bodies. ABI absence alone is not a behavior proof.

source_findings.claim: deployer,launchFactory,curve are immutable references; the source grants their addresses no token-management privileges.
source_findings.evidence: Their constructor assignments and use-only metadata getters; no privileged token setter or owner modifier.

source_findings.claim: The source mints once in constructor, supports ordinary18-decimal ERC20, and exposes no subsequent external mint, pause, blacklist or tax mechanism.
source_findings.evidence: Leaf has no transfer/_update overrides; inherited ordinary ERC20 implementation and complete18-function ABI.

source_findings.claim: burn(value) burns the caller balance and reduces totalSupply; burnFrom uses explicit allowance. This matches the PoPL Buyback required interface.
source_findings.evidence: OZ ERC20Burnable.burn -> ERC20._burn/_update and PoPL Buyback execute checks, not a nonzero target-chain execution.

source_findings.claim: The token source comment describes Pons own buybacks as vesting; PoPL separately calls burn and verifies balance/supply reduction. The two systems must not be conflated.

retained_limits: Explorer source-to-bytecode verification is an external assertion, not independent recompilation here.
Fresh runtime equality does not qualify selected PoolManager,PositionManager,Permit2,feed or other dependency controls.
Late-fee callback reachability is narrowed for this ordinary token source, not closed across every upstream path.
No pricing,liquidity,token migration promises,market fee policy or future venue qualification follows.
Upstream compiler0.8.35 has its own exact-settings/dependency review requirement before independent dependency acceptance.
